description: This file defines a React functional component 'LiteLLMModelNameField' which provides a user interface for selecting or inputting model names for a language model provider, with handling for different provider types and custom input options.

methods.name: LiteLLMModelNameField
methods.description: React functional component for selecting or inputting model names based on provider type, with logic for handling wildcards, custom names, and deployment names.

methods.name: handleModelChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the model selection, updating form fields accordingly, especially when 'all-wildcard' is selected.

methods.name: handleAzureDeploymentNameChange
methods.description: Handles input change for Azure deployment name, updating form fields with Azure-specific model mapping.

methods.name: handleCustomModelNameChange
methods.description: Handles input change for a custom model name, updating the model mappings in the form.
